text: dsh-remote 是面向 DSH Web 的远程访问插件，为浏览器界面加入登录门禁，并提供 TOTP 两步验证、账号角色管理和远程文件查看。它在 DSH 的 webServer 路由与浏览器设置界面中工作，登录后可管理账号和允许的文件目录，也可在侧栏查看常见文档、代码、图片及媒体文件。适合需要从浏览器访问已运行 DSH Web 的用户。安装后需配置或创建 DSH 账号；不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-remote adds login, TOTP sign-in, account roles, and remote file previews to DSH Web. It hooks into server routes and browser settings, where users can manage accounts and allowed directories. It is for people accessing an existing DSH Web instance from a browser and needs no external API key.

我想让 DSH Web 登录支持动态验证码和备用码。
需要给不同使用者设置管理员、普通用户和只读访客。
能不能在浏览器里查看 DSH 工作目录里的文件？
从外面连到 DSH 时，想在页面侧边预览代码和文档。
想在 DSH 设置页管理账号和可浏览的目录。
I need a sign-in and authenticator-code flow for my DSH web interface.
I want to browse workspace files in the browser without opening them on the host desktop.
dsh-remote 的登录与 MFA：访问 DSH Web 时使用账号密码登录，可继续输入 TOTP 动态码或一次性备用码；首次账号可进入引导流程。
dsh-remote 的账号角色：账号可使用 admin、user 或 guest 角色，浏览器设置页提供账号管理入口。
dsh-remote 的远程文件面板：从 DSH 界面打开工作区文件时，可在浏览器侧栏预览支持的文件类型。
dsh-remote 的允许目录管理：在设置页维护额外可浏览的绝对路径，目录列表保存在 DSH_HOME 中。
dsh-remote 的浏览器登录界面：登录、MFA 引导和设置页面提供中文与英文文案，并随 DSH 界面语言切换。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 功能概览：- **登录门禁**：未登录访问任何路径都会进入登录页；`/api` 和 WebSocket 全部要求有效会话。密码使用 scrypt 加密存储，登录失败限速，首个管理员仅限本机创建。
- **MFA 两步验证**：兼容 Google Authenticator、1Password、Authy 等标准 TOTP 认证器；支持扫码绑定和 10 个一次性备用码，管理员可以为账号关闭 MFA。
- **会话与权限**：签名会话 Cookie；默认管理员专用，可选启用 `admin` / `user` / `guest` 三级角色。
- **远程文件面板**：在右侧边栏预览代码、Markdown、图片、PDF、视频、音频、文本、目录和 `.docx` 提取文本；不支持预览的文件直接下载。默认只允许 DSH 主目录与工作目录，可在设置中添加目录。
- **远程访问**：适配 nginx、SSH 隧道、Tailscale、Frp、Cloudflare Tunnel 等方式，并完整转发 WebSocket 事件流。
- **可安装为桌面 / 手机应用**：清单、Service Worker 与图标未登录也可获取，桌面与手机浏览器都能装成独立窗口，冷启动自动修复 Cookie，见[安装为应用](#安装为应用pwa)。
- **浏览器内工作区**：选择或新建工作区使用浏览器内目录对话框，不调用宿主机原生文件窗口。
- **界面与性能**：跟随 DSH 的浅色 / 深色主题和中英文语言；远程响应默认自动 gzip 压缩，静态资源可配合边缘缓存。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 2. 重启 `dsh web`：补丁不支持热重载，安装或升级后必须重启：

```sh
dsh web
```

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 3. 创建首个管理员：在本机浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`。首次访问会进入引导模式：输入用户名和密码（至少 6 位）创建首个管理员，创建成功后自动登录。

> 服务器没有本地浏览器？见[无浏览器服务器](#无浏览器服务器headless)。
@xgone/dsh-remote README · 4. 绑定 MFA（推荐）：进入 **设置 → 登录与账号 → 双重验证（MFA）→ 启用**，用认证器扫码并输入 6 位动态码。请先保存页面上的 10 个备用码。
@xgone/dsh-remote README · 5. 开放远程访问：确认本机登录和 MFA 工作正常后，按下方[远程访问](#远程访问)配置反向代理或隧道。外部访问必须转发 WebSocket；HTTPS 部署还要设置 `session.secure: true`。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 安装为应用（PWA）：| 环境 | 入口 |
|---|---|
| 桌面 Chromium 系（Chrome、Edge、Brave 等） | 地址栏右侧的「安装」图标；或菜单 →「安装…」/「应用」→「安装此站点」。 |
| 桌面 Safari（macOS Sonoma / Safari 17 及以上） | 菜单栏 **文件 → 添加到程序坞**。 |
| Android（Chrome、Edge 等） | 菜单 →「安装应用」或「添加到主屏幕」。 |
| iOS Safari（iOS 16.4 及以上） | 分享 →「添加到主屏幕」。iOS 上 Chrome、Edge 等第三方浏览器也走同一个分享入口。 |

Firefox 不支持按清单安装 PWA（桌面与移动端都不支持），用 Firefox 时直接以浏览器标签页访问即可。

> 另有一条与本节无关的路子：Chrome / Edge 桌面版与 Safari 桌面版可以把**任意站点**安装成独立窗口（这类安装不读站点清单）。它跟上面基于清单和 Service Worker 的 PWA 安装不是一回事，别混着排查。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 安装为应用（PWA）：装好后从应用图标启动，即在独立窗口运行。插件侧已让清单、Service Worker 与图标在未登录时照常可获取，并补齐 MIME、worker 作用域与 `no-store`；`dsh-auth` Cookie 只在**已登录**的页面响应上补发、并同步注入本次请求，所以冷启动不会停在登录页。

**不需要 nginx 片段。** 上述放行全部由插件自身完成，反向代理沿用上面的配置即可；只需确认 HTTPS 证书与 `session.secure`。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 配置：编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中 `remote` 行的 `config`。常用配置如下：

```yaml
- id: remote
  config:
    enabled: true          # false = 关闭门禁（被锁在门外时的逃生通道）
    session:

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 作用 |
|---|---:|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 启用或关闭登录门禁；修改后需重启 `dsh web`。 |
| `session.secure` | `false` | HTTPS 部署时设为 `true`，让会话 Cookie 只通过安全连接发送。 |
| `adminOnly` | `true` | 保持管理员专用；设为 `false` 后启用多账号和角色权限。 |
| `bootstrap` | 未设置 | 无浏览器服务器预置首个管理员；首次登录后应移除明文密码。 |
@xgone/dsh-remote README · 配置：完整配置项（会话、MFA、限速、gzip、文件面板和允许目录）见 [docs/REFERENCE.md](docs/REFERENCE.md#13-完整配置参考cordispatchyml)。
@xgone/dsh-remote README · 无浏览器服务器（headless）：在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中加入上面的 `bootstrap` 配置节，重启后即可预置首个管理员，效果等同于本机引导。首次登录后请移除明文密码并绑定 MFA。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 常见问题：| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 安装后没有登录页 | 重启 `dsh web`；确认 bundles 列表里有 `@xgone/dsh-remote`。 |
| 创建管理员时报 403 | 首个管理员仅限本机创建：在本机浏览器操作，或通过 `ssh -L` 访问 `127.0.0.1`；无本地浏览器使用 `bootstrap`。 |
| 被锁在门外 | 将 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `enabled` 设为 `false` 后重启；或删除 `$DSH_HOME/auth/store.json` 重新引导。 |
| 忘记 MFA / 丢手机 | 管理员进入 **设置 → 登录与账号 → 该账号**，禁用 MFA。 |
| 文件面板提示 `outside-roots` | 进入 **设置 → 登录与账号 → 允许的目录** 添加该目录，立即生效，无需重启。 |
| 升级 dsh 后登录成功但 `/api` 全部 401 | 升级本插件（≥ 0.3.1）并**重新登录一次**，见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。 |
| 升级 dsh 后点文件路径没反应 / 不再进侧边栏 | 升级本插件（≥ 0.3.2）并重启 `dsh web`，见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。 |
| 升级 dsh 后远程设置页异常 / 反复弹窗 | 先升级本插件；新版 DSH 的远程兼容修复随版本内置，见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。 |
| 浏览器没有安装入口 / 装完打开是浏览器标签页 | 升级本插件（≥ 0.3.6）；确认**用 HTTPS 访问**（Service Worker 只在安全上下文注册，`http://` 的裸 IP 装不上）；Firefox 不支持按清单安装。见[安装为应用](#安装为应用pwa)。 |
| 从应用图标冷启动仍停在登录页 | 本插件 ≥ 0.3.6 会自动补发 `dsh-auth` Cookie；若仍出现，确认代理没有改写 `Host`。 |

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @xgone/dsh-remote
```

重启 `dsh web` 后门禁消失；账号数据默认保留在 `$DSH_HOME/auth/store.json`，彻底清除时再手动删除该文件。

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 已知限制：- 修改配置后必须重启 `dsh web`，Web 表面禁用 HMR。
- 多账号共享同一份工作区与会话数据。DSH 核心是单租户，插件层无法隔离；需要隔离时请为每人运行一个 profile 实例，例如 `dsh --profile alice --port 3081`。

English · 中文

**Securely expose the DeepSeek Harness Web UI to remote browsers** with a login gate, MFA/TOTP, role-based access, and an in-browser remote file panel. Users sign in from an external browser and get the full DSH experience without native dialogs on the host machine.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · dsh-remote：> Designed for environments where `dsh web` already works locally. The plugin keeps the service on loopback by default; public access still requires an HTTPS reverse proxy or a secure tunnel.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Features：- **Login gate**: unauthenticated requests to every path are sent to the login page; `/api` and WebSocket traffic require a valid session. Passwords are scrypt-hashed, failed logins are rate limited, and the first admin is loopback-only.
- **MFA / TOTP**: works with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, and other standard authenticators; supports QR binding and 10 one-time backup codes. An admin can disable MFA for an account.
- **Sessions and roles**: signed session cookies; admin-only mode by default, with optional `admin` / `user` / `guest` roles.
- **Remote file panel**: preview code, Markdown, images, PDF, video, audio, text, directories, and extracted `.docx` text in a right-side panel. Unsupported files download directly. Only the DSH home and working directories are readable by default; admins can add allowed roots.
- **Remote access**: works behind nginx, SSH tunnels, Tailscale, Frp, Cloudflare Tunnel, and similar transports with end-to-end WebSocket events.
- **Installable as a desktop or phone app**: the manifest, Service Worker, and icons are served before sign-in, so DSH installs into its own window on desktop and mobile, with the

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 2. Restart `dsh web`：Patches cannot hot-reload, so restart after installing or upgrading:

```sh
dsh web
```

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 3. Create the first admin：Open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` in a local browser. The first visit enters bootstrap mode: enter a username and password (at least 6 characters) to create the first admin, then you are signed in automatically.

> Server without a local browser? See [headless servers](#headless-servers-no-local-browser).

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 4. Bind MFA (recommended)：Go to **Settings → Auth & Accounts → Two-factor authentication (MFA) → Enable**, scan the QR code with your authenticator, and enter the 6-digit code. Save the 10 backup codes first.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · 5. Enable remote access：Verify local login and MFA first, then configure a reverse proxy or tunnel as described in [Remote access](#remote-access). External access must forward WebSockets; HTTPS deployments must also set `session.secure: true`.
@xgone/dsh-remote README · Remote access：SSH reverse tunnels, Tailscale, Frp, and Cloudflare Tunnel work the same way. For HTTPS deployments, set `session.secure` to `true` in the configuration.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Install as an app (PWA)：Since 0.3.6, DSH installs as an app in its own window — from the launcher, dock, or taskbar on desktop, from a home-screen icon on mobile — much like a native app.

**Prerequisite: serve it over HTTPS.** A Service Worker only registers in a secure context, so a plain `http://` LAN address (an unencrypted domain, a bare IP) will not install; `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` is the one exception. The same applies to desktop and mobile alike.
@xgone/dsh-remote README · Install as an app (PWA)：Steps: open the deployed HTTPS URL in a browser and sign in once, then pick the entry point for your environment.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Install as an app (PWA)：| Environment | Where to install |
|---|---|
| Desktop Chromium (Chrome, Edge, Brave, …) | The install icon at the right end of the address bar; or menu → "Install…" / "Apps" → "Install this site". |
| Desktop Safari (macOS Sonoma / Safari 17 and later) | Menu bar **File → Add to Dock**. |
| Android (Chrome, Edge, …) | Menu → "Install app" or "Add to Home screen". |
| iOS Safari (iOS 16.4 and later) | Share → "Add to Home Screen". On iOS, Chrome, Edge, and other third-party browsers route through that same share sheet. |

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Install as an app (PWA)：Firefox does not support manifest-based PWA installation, on desktop or mobile; with Firefox, just use DSH in a regular tab.

> A separate route, unrelated to this section: Chrome / Edge on desktop and Safari on desktop can install **any site** as a standalone window without reading its manifest. That is not the same as the manifest-plus-Service-Worker PWA install above — don't conflate the two when troubleshooting.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Install as an app (PWA)：Once installed, launching from the app icon runs it in its own window. The plugin already serves the manifest, Service Worker, and icons before sign-in, with the right MIME types, worker scope, and `no-store`; the `dsh-auth` cookie is re-minted only on **authenticated** page responses and injected into that same request, so a cold launch does not stop at the login page.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Install as an app (PWA)：**No nginx snippet is needed.** All of the above is handled by the plugin itself, so keep the reverse-proxy config above as-is; just confirm the HTTPS certificate and `session.secure`.

  config:

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Configuration：| Option | Default | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Enable or disable the login gate; restart `dsh web` after changing it. |
| `session.secure` | `false` | Set `true` for HTTPS so session cookies are sent only over secure connections. |
| `adminOnly` | `true` | Keep the deployment admin-only; set `false` to enable multi-account roles. |
| `bootstrap` | unset | Provision the first admin on a headless server; remove the plaintext password after the first login. |

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Configuration：See [docs/REFERENCE.md](docs/REFERENCE.md#13-full-configuration-reference) for sessions, MFA, rate limiting, gzip, the file panel, allowed roots, and all other options.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Headless servers (no local browser)：Add the `bootstrap` block above to `cordis.patch.yml` and restart. The first admin is provisioned at startup, equivalent to local bootstrap. Remove the plaintext password after the first login and bind MFA.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · FAQ：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| No login page after install | Restart `dsh web`; confirm `@xgone/dsh-remote` is in the bundles list. |
| 403 when creating the admin | The first admin is loopback-only: use a local browser or reach `127.0.0.1` through `ssh -L`; on a headless server use `bootstrap`. |
| Locked out | Set `enabled: false` in `cordis.patch.yml` and restart; or delete `$DSH_HOME/auth/store.json` to re-enter bootstrap mode. |
| Lost MFA / phone | As admin, go to **Settings → Auth & Accounts → that account** and disable MFA. |
| File panel reports `outside-roots` | Go to **Settings → Auth & Accounts → Allowed directories** and add the directory. The change applies immediately. |
| After a dsh upgrade every `/api` call returns 401 despite a successful login | Upgrade this plugin (≥ 0.3.1) and **sign in once more**; see [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md). |
| After a dsh upgrade clicking a file path does nothing / never opens the sidebar | Upgrade this plugin (≥ 0.3.2) and restart `dsh web`; see [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md). |

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @xgone/dsh-remote
```

Restart `dsh web` to remove the gate. Account data remains in `$DSH_HOME/auth/store.json`; delete that file separately for a complete reset.

@xgone/dsh-remote README · Known limitations：- Configuration changes require restarting `dsh web`; HMR is disabled on the web surface.
- All accounts share the same workspaces and session data. DSH core is single-tenant, so the plugin cannot isolate data; run one profile instance per person when isolation matters, for example `dsh --profile alice --port 3081`.
